rewrites.//: React Router owns every path. Without this the host looks for a real file at /problems/<id> or /u/<name> and returns 404 — which only shows up when someone opens a deep link or refreshes a page that is not the root.

headers.//: Hashed build output is immutable by construction, so it can be cached hard.
The brand assets keep stable filenames, so they get a short cache and revalidate.
